reviews.title: It’s easier to just use a browser
reviews.text: I am INCREDIBLY miffed with the quality of this app as of late. When I first downloaded it, it worked without demanding a subscription for everything, it let you import images and change the theme just fine. Now that I have to use it for work? Even so much as REFRESHING THE RESPONSES need to be PAID FOR. Worse? It offers you a defunct “watch an ad” option that fails to load an ad. In a similar vein, their feedback/bug report feature ALSO fails to function properly, registering my SEVERAL YEAR OLD EMAIL as “invalid” when I attempt to submit feedback. Just use your browser, because $6 a week, $60 a year, or $100 for your whole life isn’t worth the ability to scan questions and have ChatGPT write your forms for you. Google Forms is free.
